media:group.media:description:

It's one of the most common misconceptions about electric vehicles. But is it really true? Welcome to BINGO, our new series where we challenge popular EV myths, separate fact from fiction, and uncover the truth about electric mobility. In this first episode, we're putting the cost of electric vehicles to the test.
